critique: The SVG overlay is the only part that answers the Abstract Expressionist brief: the broad, wavering ribbon tentacles fade to nothing in the water, and the peach-to-coral bell gradient sits warm against the cobalt, giving a loose, painted gesture. Everything else fights it. The background video is a literal, photoreal stock-style shot of three cyan moon jellyfish, so the vector jellies (large at centre-right, small upper-left and lower-left) half-overlap their photographic twins, doubling a spare brief into six competing bodies. The video also ties the piece to the glow-on-black habit rather than a mid-key colour field. The motion misses the brief too: the script only bobs the jellies up and down on sine waves rather than drifting them downward. The fix is to drop the video for a flat or brushed colour field and let the three gestural forms carry the piece alone. The 17px guinea pig clipped at the right edge adds nothing and should go.
